title: Add Manga Maniacs activity
body:
Adds the "Manga Maniacs" activity to the initial seeded activities so it appears on the website and API.

Description: Explore the fantastic stories of the most interesting characters from Japanese Manga (graphic novels).
Schedule: Tuesdays at 7pm (7:00 PM - 8:30 PM)
Max attendance: 15

This PR seeds the database and will make the activity available in the /activities endpoint.

Closes #2
head: add/manga-maniacs
